digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation classification and recovery guidance
propositions: When attestation write fails after a PASS verdict, the error message advertises `sign-review` recovery even when the PASS sidecar was not persisted, causing recovery to fail
The `classify_plan_review_attestation` function fails to inspect the `sidecar_emitted` field before recommending `sign-review`, despite that field being available on the result dict
A missing PASS sidecar leaves a stale contradicting verdict from the previous round rather than no verdict, creating silent correctness hazard
A new `ATTESTATION_SIDECAR_LOST` cause must branch before the catch-all in `classify_plan_review_attestation` when sidecar was not emitted, recommending `review-plan` instead
The sidecar-lost recovery message must omit `sign-review` and warn that the recorded verdict is from the previous round and is not current
